map.输入收缩期压缩程度、舒张期残余狭窄、心肌桥长度与深度，并勾选缺血症状、心律失常、: Enter systolic compression, diastolic residual stenosis, myocardial bridge length and depth, and tick ischemic symptoms, arrhythmia and exercise test results, to assess myocardial bridge severity and clinical significance under the Nobel grading system and provide management strategy reference.
map.输入收缩期压缩(%)、舒张期残余狭窄(%)、长度(mm)、深度(mm): Enter systolic compression (%), diastolic residual stenosis (%), length (mm), depth (mm)
map.勾选缺血症状 / 心律失常 / 运动试验阳性: Check ischemic symptoms / arrhythmia / positive exercise test
map.按 Nobel 分级系统给出压缩程度分级: Grade the degree of compression according to the Nobel grading system
map.影像报告解读：把 CT/造影描述换算成分级: Imaging report interpretation: turn CT/angiography descriptions into grades
map.医患沟通：直观说明心肌桥程度: Doctor-patient communication: explain the degree of myocardial bridging intuitively
map.科普学习：理解表浅型与深在型差异: Popular science learning: understand the difference between superficial and deep types
map.填入收缩期压缩程度与舒张期残余狭窄: Enter systolic compression and diastolic residual stenosis
map.填心肌桥长度与深度: Enter myocardial bridge length and depth
map.勾选是否有缺血症状、心律失常、运动试验阳性: Check whether there are ischemic symptoms, arrhythmia, or a positive exercise test
map.点击「评估」查看 Nobel 分级与处理策略: Click "evaluate" to see the Nobel grade and management strategy
map.收缩期压缩 <50% 多为表浅型、临床意义小: Systolic compression <50% is mostly the superficial type and of little clinical significance

map.有缺血症状或运动试验阳性应提高警惕: Ischemic symptoms or a positive exercise test warrant greater vigilance
